build.title: Plugin commands, automatically: every plugin's commands and reads on REST, MCP and the CLI through control@1

said.text: every plugin, existing and new, automatically exposes all of its commands and reads through control@1, so they appear in the REST API, the MCP server and the CLI with no per-plugin work; Brett drives the console by talking to Claude through axHub. Base claude/token-control-opus (#250) + claude/console-commands (#249) merged in; reuses the console-commands action catalog instead of a second registry. Merges after #250 and #249.

steps.text: Command declaration: plugin.json commands (id, title, description, input schema, output, readOnly/destructive, confirm) + existing action registrations become commands
Auto surfaces: REST /api/control/<plugin>/<command>, MCP <plugin>_<command> with annotations, CLI axf <plugin> <command>, help text; hot-registered on install, removed on uninstall
Reads: list/get reads (readOnly) over every plugin's data
Backfill: every existing plugin's commands + reads declared; inventory in the report
Enforcement: lifecycle check + _template fail on unexposed actions or no reads; scaffold includes commands
Docs page, help packs, tests, theme/controls checks, report, THREADS, PR

open: AmberX and axHub-web plugins are listed (their actions are commands) but run in their own app; the console answers `not_implemented` for them until those apps take commands.

An action that acts on a row or selection (`ctx.payload`) needs its target in `input.args`; most of those are reachable through the plugin's own routes anyway (flagged as warnings by the coverage check).
POST routes that only read are writes unless the plugin declares `readOnly` (safe default: they need `control.plugins.write`).

axHub: the console's `/mcp` already goes through axHub; the hub's per-tool policy needs `<plugin>_*`, `plugin_commands`, `plugin_read`, `plugin_run` allowed (an axHub admin setting, like the `console_*` tools).
